forecast_horizon_availability_contract: all features are available at the correction time; calendar from the timestamp, day_ahead from the published RTS_DAY_AHEAD, and lagged residuals from rows with timestamps strictly before the target hour (no future leakage).
logical_feature_identity: residual correction: predicted_residual is added to day_ahead to produce the corrected forecast; correction is `corrected = day_ahead + predicted_residual`; the model is fit on the training residual `actual - day_ahead`.

transformations.calendar: sin/cos of hour, dow, doy derived from timestamp
transformations.day_ahead: RTS_DAY_AHEAD value at the target hour, published in advance
